subject: Failure-domain-aware route election for logical work lanes, preserving lane identity and provenance across provider/local/CI/MCP/PS7/future-node materializations
contradictions: Most provider-neutral principles already exist on current main; only the explicit failure-domain diversity, logical-lane persistence, and no-human-load-balancing remainder should survive fan-in.
tests: remove one synthetic route and preserve completed provenance
reroute only unfinished lanes whose capability/privacy/authority requirements remain admissible
HOLD lanes requiring unavailable unique capability
prove route changes do not replay completed work
prove model/provider count is not treated as independence by default
expected_benefit: Make logical work survive provider/runtime changes while minimizing human routing work and preserving exact provenance and authority ceilings.
risks: route diversity can be mistaken for evidence independence
automatic failover can silently violate privacy or capability constraints
fallback proliferation can increase coordination debt
wake_conditions: machine-owned route becomes available for a bounded route-failure canary
a current-main routing primitive exact-satisfies this remainder
a privacy or authority collision is discovered across candidate routes

route.route_reason: candidate doctrine only; runtime route election requires live currentness
